name: SIQ - Scroll Type Show
description: Advanced horizontal scroll text section with multiple font families per word. Mix sans-serif, serif, mono, script, condensed and display fonts in one section. Features per-word color, size, weight, italic, rotation and fill mode overrides. Multiple rows with alternating scroll directions. Outline-to-fill, dim-to-bright or solid fill modes. Gradient or solid backgrounds. 12 separator options including custom text and image.
author: SectionIQ
